title: Final Dissemination Conferences & Final Transnational Meeting in Türkiye
summary: Project partners conclude Green Horizon with final multiplier dissemination events across Germany, Romania, and Türkiye, alongside the final meeting in Mersin.
full_text: [add text] Summary of final dissemination conferences in Bonn, Brașov, and Mersin, presenting project milestones, screening documentaries, and gathering feedback from local youth and educational stakeholders. [add text] Consortium partners evaluated overall project indicators, completed the final reporting process, and adopted a post-project sustainability strategy.

photos.caption: Project team and participants reviewing project milestones and impact outcomes.

author: Green Horizon Consortium

title: Youth Climate Documentary Series and 360° VR Exhibition Launched
summary: Six short documentary films and an interactive 360-degree Virtual Reality exhibition curated on the Artsteps platform showcase youth climate perspectives.
full_text: [add text] Following extensive field production and local workshops, young participants from Germany, Romania, and Türkiye produced six compelling short documentary films highlighting regional ecological topics. [add text] The 360° Virtual Reality exhibition on Artsteps provides an immersive virtual walkthrough featuring aerial and ground photography, youth narratives, and local environmental case studies.

photos.caption: Official poster for the Youth Voices documentary series and virtual exhibition.

author: Empower Plus & Consortium

title: Local Youth Workshops Successfully Held in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye
summary: Over 60 young people across Bonn, Brașov, and Mersin participated in hands-on workshops exploring camera drone operation and environmental storytelling.
full_text: [add text] Youth workers certified during the August training mobility conducted grassroots workshops in their local communities. More than 60 young participants engaged with camera drones, learned ethical photography principles, and practiced visual documentation of regional environmental topics. [add text] Participants formed small production teams to storyboard climate issues and record initial video interviews.

photos.caption: Participants planning flight shots and storyboards during local workshop sessions.

author: Local Workshop Facilitators

title: Official 99-Page Green Horizon Educational Booklet Published
summary: The flagship 99-page open-access handbook 'Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology' is now available for download under CC BY-SA 4.0.
full_text: Integrational e.V., IESA, and Asociația Empower Plus have officially published the Green Horizon Educational Booklet: 'Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology' (Project Number: 2024-3-DE04-KA210-YOU-000293009). [add text] Structured into three clear chapters—Climate Action, Photography & Storytelling, and Drone Technology & Field Drills—the 99-page handbook provides practical guidance, safety checklists, and creative exercises for educators and youth leaders across Europe.

photos.caption: Cover of the official 99-page Green Horizon Educational Booklet.

author: IESA & Consortium Editorial Team

title: Transnational Training Course for Youth Workers Completed in Romania
summary: 18 youth workers from Germany, Romania, and Türkiye completed a 6-day intensive mobility on drone operations, safe flying, and video editing.
full_text: [add text] Hosted by Asociația Empower Plus in Brașov, Romania from 11 to 16 August 2025, 18 youth workers completed comprehensive training covering camera drone flight mechanics, EU flight safety regulations, outdoor piloting drills, and digital video editing. [add text] All 18 participants earned official Youthpass certificates recognizing their acquired competencies as multiplier facilitators.

photos.caption: The 18 participating youth workers and trainers during the outdoor field mobility in Romania.

author: Asociația Empower Plus

title: Consortium Meets in Bonn, Germany for Project Kick-Off Meeting
summary: Coordinators and youth leaders convened in Bonn on 13–14 June 2025 to finalize operational plans, quality assurance, and the project timeline.
full_text: Representatives from Integrational e.V., IESA, and Asociația Empower Plus met in Bonn, Germany for the two-day Kick-Off Meeting (Activity A1). The consortium established internal communication protocols, reviewed the bi-monthly monitoring matrix, and coordinated preparatory work for the upcoming transnational training course in Romania.

photos.caption: Consortium alignment around climate action goals and youth participation.

author: Integrational e.V.

title: Green Horizon Project Officially Launched Under Erasmus+ Youth Programme
summary: A 16-month Erasmus+ partnership commences between Germany, Türkiye, and Romania to empower youth in climate advocacy using camera drones.
full_text: On 1 May 2025, the 'Green Horizon: Youth Voices for Climate Action Through Drone Technology' project (2024-3-DE04-KA210-YOU-000293009) began under the Erasmus+ KA210-YOU scheme, co-funded with €60,000 from the European Union through the German National Agency JUGEND für Europa. Over 16 months, the initiative equips youth workers and young people with skills in camera drone piloting, environmental photography, and visual storytelling.

photos.caption: Project launch visual: Empowering European youth for climate action.
